content:
But then King Agamemnon spoke to him in turn:

"I rejoice, son of Laertes, that you have listened to my words,
for you have judged and spoken wisely.
Now I myself am willing to swear an oath, as my heart commands,
and I will not swear falsely before a god. But Achilles,
let him stay there, eager for battle like the war god Ares.
Let all others stay as well, until we bring gifts
from the ships and make solemn oaths.
And now I give you this command:
Choose the best of the Panachians as judges,
to bring the gifts from my ship that we promised to Achilles yesterday,
to give and lead women. And let Talthybius swiftly prepare
a goat throughout the wide camp of the Achaeans,
to sacrifice to Zeus and Helios."
